info.title: Meziantou.Framework.Geo.Maps.Tool
info.description: CLI to generate the offline map bundles of Meziantou.Framework.Geo.Maps: the borders, subdivisions, cities, rivers, lakes, coastline, land, ocean, seas and physical regions of the world, a continent or a country, from OpenStreetMap and Natural Earth, as folders of FlatGeobuf or GeoJSON files, GeoPackage files, or NuGet packages.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates offline map bundles for Meziantou.Framework.Geo.Maps, from OpenStreetMap and Natural Earth.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --region
options.description: The regions to build, separated by commas. A region is world, a continent (africa, antarctica, asia, europe, north-america, oceania, south-america), or a country or territory: its English name in lowercase words joined by hyphens (switzerland, united-states, cote-divoire), its key (Switzerland, UnitedStates) or its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (CH, US). The list command lists them.

options.name: --all
options.description: Builds every region: the world, the continents, and every country and territory [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: The folder of the bundles [default: maps]

options.name: --format
options.description: The format of the bundles: fgb (a folder of FlatGeobuf files per region), geojson (a folder of GeoJSON files per region) or gpkg (a GeoPackage file per region) [default: fgb]

options.name: --layers
options.description: The layers to write, separated by commas: borders, states-provinces, cities, rivers, lakes, coastline, land, ocean, marine-areas, physical-regions (default: all of them)

options.name: --previews
options.description: A folder to render a preview of each bundle to, as SVG and PNG

options.name: --pins
options.description: A file of pins to use instead of the pins of the tool, as the update-pins command writes it

options.name: --cache
options.description: The folder of the downloaded sources (default: the application data folder of the user)

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Builds the bundles of regions, and a NuGet package per bundle that copies it to the maps folder of the applications that reference it
